name: Translate Abercrombie's Note
summary: In Darkshire, Translate Abercrombie's Note brings a strange letter before the town's leaders. Mayor Ello Ebonlocke turns to Sirra Von'Indi, the scholar who knows obscure scripts.

sections.title: An Indecipherable Message
sections.body: Abercrombie sends Mayor Ello Ebonlocke a sealed letter from his home. Ebonlocke expects an eccentric plea or bitter ramblings from the cemetery hermit, but the parchment bears strange writing that ordinary Common cannot explain. Without the learning to read ancient or obscure languages, the mayor will not dismiss it. Even a mad hermit may pose a danger in Duskwood.

sections.title: The Scholar of Darkshire
sections.body: Ebonlocke sends you across the square to Sirra Von'Indi, Darkshire's scholar of esoteric lore. Sirra knows ancient arts and forgotten tongues. He scoffs at Abercrombie's sanity, saying anyone who lives beside a haunted graveyard must have a rotted brain. Still, he takes the parchment seriously and begins the slow work of transcription.

sections.title: A Glimpse into the Hermit's Mind
sections.body: Abercrombie's encoded letter points to a mind beyond the frail, reclusive old man who asks for supplies and protection from ghouls. Its message warns of a reckoning, and Darkshire is ill prepared to face it.

faq.q: Why can't Mayor Ebonlocke read the note himself?
faq.answer: The note bears strange writing that Mayor Ello Ebonlocke cannot read, so he sends it to Sirra Von'Indi, Darkshire's scholar of obscure scripts.
Sirra Von'Indi is Darkshire's scholar, known for his knowledge of obscure languages, history, and ancient arts. He examines mysterious texts and relics from the surrounding woods.
Abercrombie lives in a ramshackle shack just northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood, among restless undead and predatory beasts.

faq.q: What is Sirra's reaction to Abercrombie's note?
aliases: what does sirra think of abercrombie
faq.answer: Sirra doubts Abercrombie's sanity, saying anyone who lives beside a graveyard must have a rotted brain. Still, he examines the letter and begins translating its obscure script.

faq.q: What happens after giving the note to Sirra?
aliases: what comes after translate abercrombie note
faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi asks you to wait while he transcribes the letter. When he finishes, you carry the translation back to Lord Ello Ebonlocke.

faq.q: Why did Abercrombie write to Mayor Ebonlocke?
faq.answer: Abercrombie's note is written in a script Ello cannot read. Sirra Von'Indi's translation reveals what the hermit wrote.

angles.text: As a mage, you may recognize the work Sirra Von'Indi undertakes as he studies Darkshire's obscure scripts.
As an Alliance champion helping Duskwood, you see how vulnerable and isolated Darkshire's leaders feel amid the surrounding darkness.
